jy-01: Somnath in Saurashtra, Mallikarjuna on Srisailam, Mahakala in Ujjain, Omkareshwar / Amaleshvara.
jy-02: Vaidyanatha at Parli, Bhimashankara in Dakini, Rameshvara on the setu, Nagesha in Daruka forest.
jy-03: Vishvesha in Varanasi, Tryambaka on the Gautami, Kedara in the Himalaya, Ghushmesha in the Shivalaya.
jy-04: Who recites these jyotirlingas at dusk and dawn — sin of seven births perishes by remembrance.
